window: 4 AM Sat 31 Oct to 4 AM Sun 1 Nov IST
headline: Aadarsha Kutumbam led yesterday with 208K tickets booked, while Jailer 2 (Hindi) was the biggest mover at up 59%.
bullets: Aadarsha Kutumbam ranked first with 208K tickets, down 4% from the day before, and its busiest hour was 6:32 PM with 14.47K.
Jailer 2 was second with 159K tickets, up 33% on the day before, and Udta Teer was third with 61.7K.
Jailer 2 (Hindi) had the biggest move, rising up 59% to 28.7K, with its busiest hour at 9:08 PM.
Namit Malhotra's Ramayana has 533K+ people interested, gained 16K in 24 hours, and has bookings open for its Thu 5 Nov release.
Premada Oorali and Drishyam were also rising, up 52% and up 43% respectively.
